sections.Intro: This remedy is characterized by its action on the respiratory organs and the nervous system. It is useful in cases of chronic catarrh and chronic cough. There is a general feeling of irritation and burning. It is also useful in cases of nervous disorders, such as epilepsy and hysteria.
sections.Head: Headache, with a sensation of weight in the forehead. Vertigo.
sections.Eyes: Eyes red and burning. Itching of the eyelids.
sections.Nose: Chronic catarrh of the nose. Dryness and obstruction. Sneezing.
sections.Throat: Irritation and rawness in the throat. Hawking of mucus. Cough. Sensation of a lump in the throat.
sections.Stomach: Appetite poor. Nausea. Burning in the stomach.
sections.Respiratory: Shortness of breath. Wheezing. Violent cough, with a sensation of oppression in the chest. Hoarseness.
